const COLORS = { up: '#10b981', down: '#ef4444', partial: '#f59e0b', unknown: '#64748b' };
const LABELS = { up: 'ONLINE', down: 'OFFLINE', partial: 'PARCIAL', unknown: 'SEM DADOS' };
const CATEGORY_COLORS = {
  'Internet': '#38bdf8', 'Firewall': '#e879f9', 'Switch': '#3b82f6', 'Hardware Servidor': '#a855f7',
  'Virtualização / Servidor': '#8b5cf6', 'Access Point': '#f43f5e', 'Nobreak UPS': '#f59e0b'
};

const lastValue = (field) => {
  const raw = field && field.values ? field.values : [];
  const vals = typeof raw.toArray === 'function' ? raw.toArray() : raw;
  for (let i = vals.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (vals[i] !== null && vals[i] !== undefined) return Number(vals[i]);
  }
  return null;
};

const hostChecks = {};
const wanStatus = {};
const mergeOk = (prev, ok) => (prev === undefined || prev === null || ok === false ? ok : prev);

for (const frame of seriesData) {
  const valueField = (frame.fields || []).find((f) => f.type === 'number');
  if (!valueField || !valueField.labels || !valueField.labels.host) continue;
  const host = valueField.labels.host;
  const key = valueField.labels.item_key || '';
  const item = valueField.labels.item || key;
  const last = lastValue(valueField);
  if (frame.refId === 'B') {
    (wanStatus[host] = wanStatus[host] || []).push({ name: item, ok: last === null ? null : last === 1 });
    continue;
  }
  const ok = last === null ? null : (key === 'icmpping' ? last === 1 : (last === 1 ? true : last === 0 ? false : null));
  const kind = key === 'icmpping' ? 'ping'
    : (key.indexOf(',agent,') >= 0 || item === 'Zabbix agent availability' ? 'agent' : 'snmp');
  const c = hostChecks[host] = hostChecks[host] || {};
  c[kind] = mergeOk(c[kind], ok);
}

const CHECK_NAMES = { ping: 'ping', snmp: 'SNMP', agent: 'agente' };
const hostMember = (h) => {
  const c = hostChecks[h] || {};
  const hasPing = c.ping !== undefined && c.ping !== null;
  const reach = hasPing ? c.ping : (c.snmp === undefined ? null : c.snmp);
  const agentDown = c.agent === false || (hasPing && c.snmp === false);
  let state = 'unknown';
  if (reach === false) state = 'down';
  else if (reach === true) state = agentDown ? 'partial' : 'up';
  else if (c.agent === true) state = 'up';
  else if (c.agent === false) state = 'down';
  const checks = Object.keys(CHECK_NAMES).filter((k) => c[k] !== undefined)
    .map((k) => ({ name: CHECK_NAMES[k], state: c[k] === null ? 'unknown' : (c[k] ? 'up' : 'down') }));
  return { name: h, state: state, checks: checks };
};

let site = '.*';
try {
  if (context && context.grafana && typeof context.grafana.replaceVariables === 'function') {
    site = context.grafana.replaceVariables('$site');
  }
} catch (e) { site = '.*'; }
const allSites = !site || site === '.*' || site === '$site' || site === '$__all';

const byId = {};
const activeNodes = allNodes.filter((n) => allSites || n.siteKey === site).map((n) => {
  const members = n.wan
    ? n.hosts.flatMap((h) => (wanStatus[h] || []).map((w) => ({
        name: h + ': ' + w.name, state: w.ok === null ? 'unknown' : (w.ok ? 'up' : 'down'), checks: [] })))
    : n.hosts.map(hostMember);

  const known = members.filter((m) => m.state !== 'unknown');
  const up = known.filter((m) => m.state === 'up').length;
  const down = known.filter((m) => m.state === 'down').length;
  let state = 'unknown';
  if (known.length) state = up === known.length ? 'up' : (down === known.length ? 'down' : 'partial');

  const nodeObj = Object.assign({}, n, {
    members: members,
    state: state,
    up: up,
    total: members.length
  });
  byId[n.id] = nodeObj;
  return nodeObj;
});

  const st = n.state;
  const col = COLORS[st];
  const isDown = st === 'down';
  const isLoud = isDown || (n.core && st === 'up');

  // Pulse effect
  if (isLoud) {
    alarms.push({
      value: [n.x, n.y],
      symbolSize: n.r * (isDown ? 1.6 : 1.35),
      itemStyle: {
        color: isDown ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)' : 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25)',
        shadowBlur: isDown ? 24 : 14,
        shadowColor: col
      },
      tipData: n
    });
  }

  // Neon Glass Disc
  discs.push({
    value: [n.x, n.y],
    symbolSize: n.r,
    itemStyle: {
      color: isDown ? 'rgba(38, 12, 18, 0.95)' : (st === 'up' ? 'rgba(10, 25, 22, 0.92)' : 'rgba(36, 24, 10, 0.92)'),
      borderColor: col,
      borderWidth: isDown ? 3.5 : 2.5,
      shadowBlur: isDown ? 28 : (st === 'up' ? 16 : 12),
      shadowColor: col
    },
    tipData: n
  });

  // SVG Line Icon centered
  iconItems.push({
    value: [n.x, n.y],
    symbol: iconUri(n.icon || 'server', col),
    symbolSize: Math.round(n.r * 0.52),
    silent: true
  });

  // Compact Non-overlapping Label Plate
  textItems.push({
    value: [n.x, n.y + n.r / 2 + 12],
    tipData: n,
    label: {
      show: true,
      position: 'inside',
      formatter: '{pip|●} {name|' + n.name + '}\n{sub|' + (n.sub || '') + '}',
      rich: {
        pip: { color: col, fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 900 },
        name: { color: '#f8fafc', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 13 },
        sub: { color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 12 }

      backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92)',
      borderColor: col,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderRadius: 4,
      padding: [3, 6],
      shadowBlur: 6,
      shadowColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'
    }
  });
});

  const src = byId[l.source];
  const tgt = byId[l.target];
  if (!src || !tgt) return;

  const isBad = src.state === 'down' || tgt.state === 'down';
  const edgeColor = isBad ? COLORS.down : l.color;
  const curveness = l.curveness || 0;

  const coords = [[src.x, src.y], [tgt.x, tgt.y]];
  const tipText = '<b>' + src.name + '</b> ➔ <b>' + tgt.name + '</b>' +
    (l.label ? '<br><span style="color:#38bdf8;">' + l.label + '</span>' : '');

  linesStatic.push({
    coords: coords,
    lineStyle: {
      color: edgeColor,
      width: isBad ? 2.8 : l.width,
      type: isBad ? 'dashed' : (l.dashed ? [6, 4] : (l.dotted ? [3, 3] : 'solid')),
      curveness: curveness,
      shadowBlur: isBad ? 16 : l.glow,
      shadowColor: edgeColor
    },
    tipText: tipText
  });

  if (!isBad) {
    linesFlowing.push({
      coords: coords,
      lineStyle: {
        curveness: curveness,
        opacity: 0,
        width: 1
      }
    });
  }
});

    formatter: function(params) {
      if (params.data && params.data.tipData) {
        const d = params.data.tipData;
        const rows = (d.members || []).map((m) => {
          const checks = (m.checks || []).map((c) =>
            `<span style=\"color:${COLORS[c.state]};\">${c.name} ●</span>`).join(', ');
          return `<div><span style=\"color:${COLORS[m.state]};\">●</span> <b>${m.name}</b>` +
            (checks ? ` <span style=\"color:#94a3b8;\">(${checks})</span>` : '') + `</div>`;
        }).join('') || '<div style=\"color:#94a3b8;\">Sem item de disponibilidade no Zabbix</div>';
        return `
          <div style=\"font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;color:${COLORS[d.state]};margin-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #334155;padding-bottom:4px;\">
            ${d.name} (${d.sub || ''})
          </div>
          <table style=\"font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#cbd5e1;margin-bottom:6px;\">
